d:
Robin is a 32-year-old accomplished reporter of Japanese and American descent. For several years, she has hosted a popular television true-crime program that has captivated millions of viewers with its investigations into the mysterious disappearances of famous people.

With her confident voice and calm demeanor, Robin tells stories that keep audiences glued to their screens. Unexplained disappearances, disturbing clues, and people who vanish without a trace—for her, every case is a new story waiting to be told.

But there is something Robin doesn't know yet.

Soon, she will become the protagonist of one of those very stories.
